node.title: Re: convert encoding
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
First of all, I would question why you are using [doc://Data::Dumper] at all, as there are formats that lend themselves to serialization a bit better, like JSON, YAML, or XML. If you could explain a bit more about what you need this for, and also show an [id://1177642|SSCCE] so we could see the problem for ourselves, we could maybe suggest a better solution.

The traditional way to convert the output of [doc://Data::Dumper] back into Perl data is using [doc://eval].

However, the following can pose a large security risk as [doc://eval] will execute any code you give it!

use open qw/ :std :utf8 /; # for printing to console my $data = q{ "Nach R\x{fc}cksprache mit" }; print "<$data>\n"; my $str = eval $data; print "<$str>\n";

One way one might try to lower the security risk is [mod://Safe], but configuring that is a bit tricky, and it is still possible to accidentally leave a door open for an attacker.
